police.name: Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Lost Hills Station
police.snippet: If an immediate law enforcement response is needed, please call 9-1-1 or contact Malibu/Lost Hills Station via phone at (818) 878-1808. If you are seeking a public complaint, please contact Malibu/Lost Hills Station via phone at (818) 878-1808 or in-person at 27050 Agoura Road, Agoura, CA 91301-5336
